title: Quantum Advantage: a Tensor Network Perspective
summary: We review the recent quantum advantage experiments by IBM, D-Wave, and Google, focusing on cases where efficient classical simulations of the experiment were demonstrated or attempted using tensor network methods. We assess the strengths and limitations of these tensor network-based approaches and examine how the interplay between classical simulation and quantum hardware has advanced both fields.
